notablePrerequisites:
Naga Fleshcrafter on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Naga Fleshcrafter do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Naga Fleshcrafter.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Naga Fleshcrafter.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
